It can be converted into a type of fuel called "plastic-derived fuel" (PDF), which can be used to power vehicles and machinery.  3. Construction material: Plastic waste can also be used as a construction material. It can be shredded and mixed with cement to create a durable and lightweight building material.  4. Art: Plastic waste can also be used to create art. Many artists use plastic waste to create sculptures, paintings, and other works of art that can be sold for profit.  Overall, there are many ways in which plastic waste can be used to generate wealth.
